notes: Model-specific text-semantics decoding calibration profile (ADR 0056) for the Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507-8bit engine executed through the Model runtime subprocess (ADR 0055) with mlx-lm. model_identity binds the exact pinned model asset SHA-256, the mlx-lm backend and version, the 8-bit precision, the apple-m1 device class, and the text-analysis rules fingerprint; any bound-identity change invalidates the profile. prompt_template_version binds the versioned prompt template the profile was calibrated for, so a prompt revision invalidates the profile. decoding fixes the deterministic sampling controls: temperature 0.0 is decoded as greedy argmax and seed makes the (already deterministic) run reproducible, max_tokens bounds the generation length, and max_kv_size bounds the KV cache so peak memory stays within the 12 GiB envelope on this device. qualification_scope is 'first_device_baseline': these settings qualify the real engine only for offline engineering verification here; the Chinese/English semantic quality of the selection is confirmed only by the maintainer sample review in the Phase 11 prototype ticket, not by this record. Model-proposed boundaries and content are always validated against the revalidated cue evidence by the unchanged Text-model output projection and adjudication, so this profile never makes unproven model output authoritative.
